strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. Dancougar is destroyed
They're thinning out. Let's push through all at once!
Isn't the problem that there are so few? Shinobu, where are we?
Who cares about that crap? We're in space, space!
They may be Gaizok mecha, but they're all small fry.
It's pointless if we let that clay-doll battleship get away.
Hey, are you even listening!? Shinobu!
Shut up! I'm telling you there's enemies right in front of us!
We take care of these guys first!
Hey, Ryo, isn't something weird about this place?
Hmm... That thing, you mean.
What? Looks like someone hollowed out the asteroid belt.
Unless some kind of special force field was generated...
that sort of thing shouldn't happen in space...
Hey, you guys! What are you yammering about that crap for!?
I told you, the enemy in front of us comes first!
Yeah, yeah. You don't have to yell, we can hear you.
Our leader has a point.
Something merely suspicious, versus something actually attacking...
It's obvious which to deal with first.
Fair enough. Okay, Shinobu, we're good to go.
Quit dragging your feet! Let's do this!
Phew, so many of them is a real pain.
Still no contact with Londo Bell!?
...That's weird.
I'm sending a distress signal, but it seems like... it's being jammed.
The Gaizok mecha?
No, doesn't look like it. ...If anything, maybe it's over there.
Over where?
...That space over there, huh?
What's that supposed to mean... Hm!?
Something on radar!? Heads up, something's coming!
What the hell? A whole swarm of 'em. Is that Londo Bell?
Doesn't look like it to me! They're... coming at us!?
Doesn't look like they want to make friends. Shinobu! What now?
Heh, bring it! I was just thinking this wasn't enough.
I'll shoot 'em all down!
No metal, no thermonuclear, no life signs...?
That's worrying. Then what the heck are these things...
So this is the point! Cyber Beast Force,
this is Bright Noa of Londo Bell, an independent Federation unit.
Oh, looks like they've arrived.
Wow, so that's Dancougar? It has four pilots, just like Dangaioh.
Heh, headcount's got nothing to do with strength. Are they any good?
You may not know, but in the battle against the last invaders...
it was that super robot that brought us victory.
So they're strong, then!
Let's hurry and support them.
They should be dependable in terms of firepower...
But they're known as "the insubordinate Cyber Beast Force,"
so goodness knows how this will go...
They say they got separated from the Mazinger team because they
launched on their own judgment...
Still, they're soldiers, technically, right?
Captain Bright must find them easier to use than a civilian ship.
Captain, Captain Bright asks us to launch and back up the Cyber Beasts.
Roger. Prepare the Aestivalis for launch at once!
Ruri, what's the enemy deployment?
Gaizok Mecha Boosts confirmed. Also several unrecorded types.
What are those mecha the Cyber Beast Force is fighting?
Never seen that type... A new Gaizok model, maybe?
No... They aren't machines? What does that mean?
Anyway, give the order to launch, Captain!
Yeah, yeah! We're getting nowhere like this.
It'd be awful for them with no repair equipment, too.
They're clearly enemies, Captain.
If we dawdle, those Cyber Beast guys might go missing again.
I wouldn't want that to keep happening.
Let's launch, I tell ya!
The enemy aside, something about this space itself is off...
But it can't be helped... All units, launch!
Took your sweet time getting here! I'm sick of waiting, Captain!
You're one to talk, after ignoring the rendezvous point and taking off!
What!? If you'd kept that clay-doll creep pinned down properly,
we wouldn't have had to take off in the first place!
Charging out isn't everything. You ended up stranded anyway.
What was that, you punk?
Knock it off, Shinobu! They'll think we're all troublemakers!
So they really are... a reckless bunch...
Just so you know, Shinobu's the only idiot here! Keep that in mind.
Is that so? You all seem about the same to me...
Good grief.
Image is everything, you know~
Battle Mastery increased by 1.
It seems all enemies in this area have been destroyed.
Yes... And the Cyber Beast Force seems safe too.
Cyber Beast Force, I heard about it from the Mazinger and Zambot teams.
Good work out there.
Well, if Shinobu hadn't lost his patience and charged off,
I think we'd have met up a lot more smoothly.
Anyway, the Cyber Beast Force... Shinobu Fujiwara, Sara Yuki,
Masato Shikibu, and Ryo Shiba, transferring to Londo Bell as of now.
We're in your hands, Captain Bright.
Understood. The pleasure's mine.
Dancougar... I haven't seen it since the Nadesico launched...
Yeah... In space, that black body and silver wings look even cooler!
Is that really the point?
Oh, looks like the Nadesico joined up with Londo Bell too.
Seems you didn't vanish in the chaos of battle this time.
Ahaha... You remember that well, Lieutenant Shiba...
Anyone would remember someone who vanished mid-battle.
Hey, Fujiwara! Your stunt made things rough for us too, y'know!?
Well, it worked out in the end... We're all safe.
Bright's here now, so no more reckless stuff, okay?
This time it only turned out well by luck.
It's pointless. Fujiwara especially won't listen.
Don't sweat the small stuff. Come on, let's head for the next point.
The small stuff...?
If you jump out of an HLV, you know what that leads to...
Oh, come on, Brother's so serious.
Isn't it fine? It all worked out in the end.
Daisuke's a real stiff, I tell ya.
Heh heh, sorry about that.
People who don't like Shinobu really don't like him.
...He seems hard to get along with.
Boys are better off with a bit of spirit like that, Lieutenant Uraki.
They're certainly reliable comrades. Captain...
Right. All units, return! Don't neglect maintenance.
The Ra Cailum will head to the next point.
Roger! Yay, we're getting more allies, this is great!
Seriously. ...Huh? What's up with the Cyber Beast Force?
...Something's... off.
Yeah, something's bugging me. This area... like someone's watching us...
